title: A check for a new attribution rule also covers a session that must not be attributed
goal: Answers the SP-mlemdqbn retrospective: TK-nwxefymo's check proved a worker session's prompts count on its item, but no check covered a session that must not count (a stale work/<id> checkout, an orchestrator whose hook cwd passed a worker worktree), so the review found S2 BG-lbazs72w after landing. kb-sprint plan step 6 and kb/_self/backlog.md Sprints (Plan) say that a committed item whose goal adds or widens a rule that attributes rows, windows or cost to an item carries, beside its positive check, one check that a session outside the rule is not attributed.

run: import pathlib,sys;F=(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md","kb/_self/backlog.md");r=[any("not attributed" in l for l in pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()) for f in F];print(r);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)
